author: Tempus
body:
So, if you don't know what Munchkin is, I refer you to their website - http://www.worldofmunchkin.com/

I'd be up for playing through roll20.net. If you want to play, post your skype and your roll20 name. 

Once I've created the campaign (ie once I have enough members), I'll post the link here.
